subject: Re: Kickoff: dictionary learning for embedding-table compression
body:
Anders,

Plan and staffing.

April: Efe characterizes the method on synthetic tables -- error vs. row_percentage/col_percentage curves, plus sensitivity to n_iterations (the default 32 may be low for our table sizes). Wanjiru pulls anonymized copies of the two production tables.

May is the heavy month: Saoirse Eriksen is committed at 65% to this project for May 2026 to own the factorization sweeps and the serving integration spike. Leilani supports at 25% on the eval side, measuring retrieval quality (not just reconstruction error) on compressed tables.

June: integration plan and writeup before the Q3 OKR lock on June 26.

Compute is trivial for once -- this is CPU/NumPy work, no cluster ask. The scarce resource here is people, hence the explicit May allocations.

Jelena
